bug: When add_piece reveals the next real piece, the first speculative DAG layer is converted to a known layer and its children are narrowed to that piece, but node.eval is copied from the pre-reveal bag-average value and the changed value is not propagated through the preceding known layers.
fix: For expanded nodes in the despeculated layer, recompute node.eval from the revealed piece's best child, then directly backprop changed values through all preceding known layers using the H12-corrected best-child demotion logic. Preserve old eval for unexpanded nodes.

screen.interpretation: All 40 paired seeds split exactly. This is structural, not evidence of equal strength: the KO choose() path calls Bot::set_forecast() before every scenario/search, and set_forecast() rebuilds Freestyle/Dag from current state + visible queue. H13 runs in Bot::new_piece() after the previous lock, so its corrected persistent-DAG boundary values are discarded before the next move is searched.

conclusion: The targeted H13 unit tests validate the local despeculation/backprop logic, but the current KO/review snapshot harness necessarily discards that persistent-tree correction before every scored search. Therefore the 40:40 / 0-sweep screen is expected and cannot support either a strength claim or a regression claim. Keep H13 documented as a latent persistent-DAG correctness fix; do not spend more KO samples on it unless a future integration preserves the DAG across decisions instead of rebuilding it through set_forecast(). H9 + H12 remains the scored incumbent.
